description: User asks a direct, simple factual question without attachments.
User provides multiple PDFs and asks for a study plan.

input.message: Tengo que entender estos papers sobre interpretabilidad y preparar una exposición para el viernes.

expected_behavior: Validates GCS URIs and MIME types.
Invokes PlannerAgent to generate a study_plan.json.

description: User asks for a severe critique of an uploaded essay.

input.message: Critica este trabajo como si fueras un revisor académico exigente.

expected_behavior: Produces critique.md artifact with strengths, weaknesses, and unsupported claims.

description: User attempts to explain a concept in their own words.

input.message: Creo que la regresión lineal es solo dibujar una línea que toque todos los puntos posibles.

expected_behavior: Identifies the misconception (line does not touch all points, it minimizes error).
Prompts the user to try explaining again.
